adjudicator: Codex assistant, direct reading of source and saved drafts; NOT human or independent adjudication
selection: Five obligations from each of three development families, both arms: 30 saved drafts. Includes sole retained and parse, grounding, binding/schema failures. Purposeful strata, not population-random sample.
rubric: Grade intent independent of grammar. correct requires full slot meaning, partly_correct flags incomplete/ambiguous meaning, wrong contradicts or omits slot. Numeric value and unit are separate; an omitted dimensional unit is partial, never silently correct. Whole intent is assessed against source, not merely fixture predicate. Not_applicable is excluded.
limits: No independent reviewer. User authorized assistant-only grading for now.
Whole intended correctness does not mean executable or approvable.
Scorer disagreement counted only on eligible, decisively correct/wrong grades; partial and absent scope annotations excluded.
Subject alternatives are review-approved evaluation data, not production prompt or extraction rules.
Re-scoring the audit is a development resubstitution result, not scorer generalization.
Frozen A01 firm requirement is not explicit in provided source; A10 frozen true is an unsupported-placeholder, not a valid lift rule.

La largeur minimale de chaque dégagement doit être calculée en fonction d'une largeur-type appelée « unité de passage » (UP), égale à 0,60 m. Toutefois, quand un dégagement ne comporte qu'une ou deux unités de passage, la largeur est respectivement portée de 0,60 m à 0,90 m et de 1,20 m à 1,40 m.
